summary: Iteration 4 full regression PASSED. All user requests verified: (1) iOS PaymentModal fixed — mobile 390x844 renders SOLID white fullscreen at top=0/left=0/w=390/h=844 with filter:none, backdropFilter:none, opacity:1, and Total Pembayaran + 4 payment methods + QRIS QR + Konfirmasi Lunas button all visible (screenshot confirmed). (2) Font stack correctly reports '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", ...' on both body and headings. (3) Theme/font switchers hidden: .header-theme-toggle display:none, .settings-theme-grid and .settings-font-grid not in DOM (removed). (4) All 9 routes have zero horizontal overflow at 1440x900 (scrollWidth=clientWidth=1440). (5) Entrance animations selasar-fade-up applied to .product-card and .category-pill. (6) Sidebar rotating promo .selasar-sidebar-promo exists on every route with span/strong/small; content rotates every ~4.2s (verified 'Gunakan meja saat dine-in.' -> 'Ajak pelanggan jadi member.' after 5s). (7) Desktop 1440 PaymentModal shows centered card inside fullscreen overlay backdrop — screenshot confirms Total gradient card, 4 method cards, QR code and Konfirmasi Lunas button rendered nicely.

issues: main-content firstChild width is 1186 (viewport 1440 - sidebar 254). max-width:1240 cap does not activate at 1440 viewport, so right whitespace is 0. This matches spec (max-width 1240 with auto margin only produces symmetric whitespace when viewport > 1240+sidebar). At >=1500 viewport, whitespace becomes balanced. Not a defect; note only if user expected padding at 1440.

test_results.overflow_1440x900_all_routes: PASS (pos, kds, tables, reports, loyalty, inventory, menu_manager, settings, shift — all scrollWidth==clientWidth==1440)

desktop_payment_1440x900.modal: centered card visible with Total gradient, 4 payment method cards, QRIS QR, Konfirmasi Lunas — screenshot confirmed

critical_code_review_comments: Content centering at 1440: max-width 1240 auto-margin only balances whitespace when viewport - sidebar > 1240. At 1440 viewport, content fills area next to sidebar (1186px). If user wants explicit lateral padding at 1440, add horizontal padding on .main-content > * or reduce max-width. Otherwise current behaviour is correct per spec.
Preview harness ('mobile-cart-backdrop') can intercept pointer events during Playwright click; tests should use JS-native click for reliability in the mobile cart -> payment flow.
seed_data_creation: None (used /preview-pos.html seed harness with add-to-cart via product card + modal footer checkout, then Bayar via JS-native click on .pos-cart-sidebar .cart-footer .checkout-btn)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 4 acceptance: PaymentModal iOS fix (isolation:isolate, no transform on ancestor .pos-layout, split animation) verified working — modal getBoundingClientRect().top===0 at 390x844, opacity=1, background solid white, no filter/backdrop-filter blur. SF Pro font, hidden theme/font switchers, centered content, entrance animations, and rotating sidebar promo all pass. If retesting mobile payment: use JS-native click (btn.click()) on '.pos-cart-sidebar .cart-footer .checkout-btn' — Playwright force click can be intercepted by the mobile-cart-backdrop element.
